dedupe_keys.name: paddy rice cropping intensity and planting dates for monsoon asia at 20 m 2018 2021

description: Maps of how many rice crops a year are grown and when they are planted across Monsoon Asia. The Zenodo record says a sample-free algorithm uses Sentinel-1 radar to find transplanting signals in backscatter series, checked with optical, infrared and passive microwave data, to map paddy rice cropping intensity and planting dates at 20 m for 2018 to 2021. Validation on 2,305 field samples and 1,484 public samples gives 82 to 84 per cent overall accuracy, and regional mean planting dates agree with the RiceAtlas statistics (R2 0.92, RMSE 28 days). Two archives (4.07 and 3.31 GB) are a free download under CC BY 4.0, published 2 April 2025. Coverage is Monsoon Asia. Caveats: accuracy varies by region. For simulation planting dates show when rice is in the field and so which growing stage a flood or drought would hit. A related catalogue record is GlobalRice20.
